styles.name: Tibard chef trousers, elasticated waist — regular length, black
styles.desc: Chefs trousers · Full elasticated waist · Zip fasten · One patch pocket on back RHSAW · Hemmed trouser · Regular length · Black
styles.lectra: CT0196 — variant CT0196 for sizes XS to XXL; 0196BIG — variant 0196BIG for sizes 48" to 70" — regular length
fabrics: Black 65% recycled polyester / 35% organic cotton X133ECO-AM125 (Tiajo) — rating 1.30 m on 60" wide fabric, size M or L
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BLACK 09700 — cost per metre
Wash instructions label: 60° wash · two dot iron · no bleach · low tumble dry · P dry clean. Set to the inside back seam, 12 cm down from the cut edge, to finish 8 cm inside the back seam.
Tibard tax tab set to the outside edge under the pocket hem (outside leg side of the pocket, level with the pocket hem stitching).
mfg: Pocket hem double turned 1 cm + 1.5 cm and topstitched 1.5 cm. Pocket edge stitched on three sides. Tibard tax tab set to the outside leg side of the pocket, level with the pocket hem stitching.
Pocket set to back right leg as worn. Set centrally and parallel with the outside leg edge. Top of the pocket set level with the notch. Pocket to finish 10 cm down from the finished waist.
Fly front 21 cm long with a curve around the bottom. 8 cm of topstitching from the top of the trouser down. Ensure this stitching is back-tacked at the fly top / waistband to secure.
Wash label set to the inside back seam, 12 cm down from the cut edge, to finish 8 cm inside the back seam.

Cut the elastic at the required size (see the Elastic trim line) and overlap the ends by 2.5 cm (1"). Overlock to neaten the top edge of the waist. Turn the waistband over 3.5 cm and insert the elastic. Set two rows of stitching at the waist to secure the elastic.
Bottom hem overlocked and turned up 1.5 cm, stitched on the overlock and NOT on chain stitch.
Make-up sheet available.
fin: Bar tack the patch pocket mouth with vertical bartacks, and a vertical bartack at the bottom of the fly.
Trim and fold, showing the pocket on the top.
styles.tol: Waist ± 2 cm · Thigh ± 2 cm · Length +2 cm
styles.note: Stock works order CT0196--03 (work order 1325, Gail, issued 24/9/26 for 45 x CT0196LL03; created YL 12.5.14, measurements JH 4/1/18, set to stock YL 20/3/18, model and variant corrected JH 9/4/26). Rating 1.30 m on 60" wide fabric at size M or L; All Costings carries 1.25 m. Document: works-orders/CT0196-03-Stock.xlsx.
